title: AI Builder - Simply Explained
description:
Many business users think AI needs engineers and months of setup. This Simply Explained episode is for Power Platform beginners who want to use AI Builder inside Power Apps and Power Automate. You will learn which models fit which tasks, how document processing and prediction work, and how credits and licensing affect your plans.
In this episode
00:00 – AI already inside the tools you use00:31 – What AI Builder actually is02:13 – Ready-made models versus models you build04:10 – Why this is not just another chatbot05:17 – What document processing really does06:50 – How prediction works09:23 – What credits are and why they matter11:10 – Where AI Builder fits in real work
Key takeaways
AI Builder adds task-focused AI models to Power Apps and Power Automate, so you can automate business chores without writing code.Use pre-built models for common, generic problems and train custom models such as document processing when your documents or data are specific to your business.Building and testing models is free, but running them in a live app or flow consumes credits and makes the flow or app premium.
Worth quoting
“AI builder is a feature inside Microsoft Power Platform. It lets you create and use AI models to take over business tasks you'd normally do by hand.” – Mirko Peters (00:33)
“Most beginners assume custom always means better, and that assumption is wrong. Custom means more specific, and more specific is only better when your problem is specific to.” – Mirko Peters (03:55)
